components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The main action of a card in Needs you, filled with Ink.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn ds-btn-primary"><svg class="ds-icon" viewBox="0 0 16 16"><path d="M5 3.5v9l7-4.5z"/></svg>Run plan</button>

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: A secondary action with a Veil fill and a hairline border.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 28px; padding: 0 11px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.07); border-radius: 8px; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05); color: #ededf0; font: 500 12.5px / 1 Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.15s, border-color 0.15s, transform 0.1s; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.13); background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.085); } .ds-btn-ghost:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #5ea2ff; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.css: .ds-views { display: inline-flex; gap: 2px; height: 30px; padding: 2px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.07); border-radius: 9px; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05); } .ds-views button { height: 24px; padding: 0 10px; border: 0; border-radius: 7px; background: transparent; color: #8d8d97; font: 500 12.5px / 1 Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.15s, color 0.15s; } .ds-views button:hover { color: #ededf0; } .ds-views button[aria-pressed="true"] { background: #19191d; color: #ededf0; box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.035) inset, 0 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25); } .ds-views button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #5ea2ff; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Waiting Card with Lane Track
components.description: The beacon of the tower: a card that waits for the maintainer, with its lane track.
components.html:
#231·feature

Show the effort level on each ready card

waits for your answer · 4m
components.css: .ds-card { position: relative; isolation: isolate; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; width: 360px; padding: 12px 14px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.07); border-radius: 12px; background: #19191d; box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.035) inset, 0 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25); color: #a6a6af; font: 400 13px / 1.5 Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-waits { border-color: color-mix(in srgb, #ff7a45 55%, transparent); background: color-mix(in srgb, #ff7a45 6%, #19191d); } .ds-waits::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: -1; border-radius: inherit; background: color-mix(in srgb, #ff7a45 10%, transparent); animation: ds-attention 3s cubic-bezier(0.45, 0, 0.55, 1) infinite; } @keyframes ds-attention { 0%, 100% { opacity: 0.15; } 50% { opacity: 1; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-waits::before { animation: none; opacity: 0.7; } } .ds-head { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; height: 18px; font: 400 11.5px / 1 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; color: #a6a6af; } .ds-track { display: inline-flex; gap: 3px; margin-left: auto; } .ds-track i { width: 14px; height: 4px; border-radius: 2px; background: color-mix(in srgb, #8d8d97 28%, transparent); } .ds-track i.ds-done { background: color-mix(in srgb, #8d8d97 80%, transparent); } .ds-track i.ds-now { width: 20px; background: #ff7a45; } .ds-title { margin: 0; font: 600 14px / 1.38 Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.012em; color: #ededf0; } .ds-foot { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; } .ds-status { color: #ff7a45; font-size: 12px; } .ds-go { height: 28px; padding: 0 11px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: #ededf0; color: #111114; font: 500 12.5px / 1 Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-go:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #5ea2ff; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
The board is a watch post over many agents at once. From one seat, the maintainer sees every session and every issue of one repository, and the one thing that needs them stands out from the rest. The tower is quiet at rest: the surface is near-neutral grey and the furniture recedes. Color appears only as a signal, and each signal has one meaning.

The mood is calm, precise, and utilitarian. The density is high but ordered: small type (13px body), tight controls (28px), and a strict three-column field. The page must read at a glance after hours of use, so it uses no decorative graphics. It is never a marketing dashboard: no decorative gradients, no charts, no hero graphics. The board shows nothing of one product. Only the folder name of the checkout appears in the header, so the same look fits any repository.

The board follows the light or dark theme of the OS. Dark is the base definition, and light redefines every color token. It loads nothing from the network and carries its own two fonts.
keyCharacteristics: Neutral grey surfaces in three tonal layers: page, column, card.
Five state colors, each with one meaning, used only for state.
Hairline borders and translucent fills instead of heavy shadows.
Geist for words and Geist Mono for numbers, paths, and identifiers.
Small, dense, keyboard-first controls with a visible focus ring.
Motion only for state: the beacon pulse, the working flow, and card moves. All of it stops for reduced motion.

rules.name: The One Meaning Rule
rules.body: Each signal color has one meaning: orange needs you, blue works, green is ready or passed, red failed, amber is a dirty tree. Never use a signal color for decoration, brand, or emphasis.

rules.name: The Ink Action Rule
rules.body: The primary button is filled with Ink, not with a signal color. A filled button means "the main action of this card", not a state.

rules.name: The Tint Not Fill Rule
rules.body: A state reaches a surface only as a `color-mix` tint (6–13% for backgrounds, 22–55% for borders) over the neutral layer. Never fill a card or chip with a solid signal color.

rules.name: The Machine Text Rule
rules.body: Text that a machine wrote, or that a person copies (a number, a path, a command), is set in Geist Mono. Text written for a person to read is set in Geist.

rules.name: The Four Weights Rule
rules.body: Use 400 for reading, 500 for controls, and 600 for titles and labels. Do not add a weight above 600 for emphasis; use Ink color instead.

rules.name: The Two Shadows Rule
rules.body: A surface in the page uses Raise or nothing. Only a layer that floats above the page uses Float. No other shadow exists.

rules.name: The Ring Not Glow Rule
rules.body: Selection and focus are rings: a 2px Current Blue outline with a 2px offset for focus, and a 1px Ink Faint ring for the selected card. Never use a colored glow.

rules.name: The Nesting Rule
rules.body: A child radius is never larger than its parent radius. A 7px tab sits in a 9px track; a 12px card sits in a 16px column.

dos: **Do** keep every surface neutral grey and give color only to state, per the One Meaning Rule.
**Do** tint a state onto a surface with `color-mix` (6–13% fill, 22–55% border).
**Do** set numbers, SHAs, paths, commands, and effort levels in Geist Mono.
**Do** define every new color for both themes: the dark base and the light variant.
**Do** use the existing ease `cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1)` for entrances and 0.15s for color and border transitions.
**Do** stop all animation and transition under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`.
**Do** check every change at desktop width and at 375×812 in Chromium.
donts: **Don't** add decorative gradients, charts, illustrations, or hero graphics. The board is not a marketing dashboard.
**Don't** fill a button or a card with a solid signal color.
**Don't** add a shadow other than Raise and Float.
**Don't** load a font, an icon, or a script from the network.
**Don't** show a product's brand, logo, or colors; only the folder name identifies the repository.
**Don't** use a colored glow for focus or selection; use a ring.
